source: BEA Supply-Use summary tables 2017 + project tariff schedule
known_limitations: BEA summary commodities are far broader than HS6 lines. A summary commodity that contains both tariffed and untariffed HS6 products receives an import-weighted average rate, so industry-level exposure is attenuated relative to the true product-level shock, and heterogeneity within a commodity is lost entirely.
HS-to-commodity concordance status: COARSE_APPROXIMATION. Exposure magnitudes are an ordering, not elasticities, and must not feed a welfare calculation.
Direct requirements are normalised by the intermediate-input column total, not by total industry output including value added, so shares are input shares of intermediate purchases.
